== Update May 8, 2026 ==

* Inside [[Tunnels of the Forsaken]]:
** Moved use of enemy elite skills to hard mode only 
** Tunnels of the Forsaken dungeon tuning:
*** Adjusted drops for ghosts.
*** Adjusted difficulty of scaling mobs by removing a passive that gave many of the scaling mobs health regeneration.
*** Increase odds of rare drops at all scaling levels.
*** Permanently opened Maz gates in post-searing dungeon.
*** Move elite skills to hard mode for basic enemies.
*** Remove double elite from Fractured Spirit.
